note: The passages describe the national identity card biometric database (photos and fingerprints, digitised by a private contractor since 2008) and government payments; 'commissariat' is the UN refugee agency. Nothing on police or gendarmerie stations or their records; the identity card database is a civil identity system that fits none of the typology's classes as described, so its class is left empty.
